newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea April trade deficit narrows to $1.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea April trade deficit narrows to $1.5 bln.

text.p: South Korea's customs-cleared trade deficit narrowed to $1.5 billion in April from a $2.04 billion shortfall a year earlier, provisional figures released by the trade ministry showed on Thursday.
NOTE: in millions of dollars, March figures revised
South Korea's customs-cleared trade deficit totalled $8.98 billion in the first four months of this year, up from $6.21 billion in the same 1996 period, the ministry figures showed.
The ministry said in a statement FOB exports rose 7.0 percent in April year-on-year, while CIF imports gained a mere 1.6 percent.
The April export growth marked the first monthly rise for 1997. Exports posted negative growth in January to March.
"Moreover, this is the first time since last June that export growth has outpaced import growth," the ministry said.
